title: Add heterogeneous-shot stability checker and compact snapshot comparator for prompt regressions
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: regression noise from few-shot / context variability can mask real model regressions. Teams have requested a lightweight CI-friendly tool that compares compact snapshots of output distributions across heterogeneous shot configurations (0-shot, 1-shot, random-k-shot) and raises percentile-aware quality gates. This PR implements a stability metric and on-pipeline snapshot comparator to detect prompt-set regressions that are driven by sensitivity to example selection or seed variability.

What this change does: introduces a HeterogeneousShotStabilityChecker that: 1) executes a prompt-set against a configurable set of shot-variation strategies (none, fixed exemplar, random sampled exemplars, stratified exemplar sampling) and random seeds; 2) computes per-query fingerprints (tokenized-response hash, normalized length, token saliency sketch) and aggregate distribution metrics (pairwise KL on token n-gram distributions, median pairwise edit distance, percentile stability score); 3) emits a compact snapshot (.hssnap) containing the sample-level fingerprints and telemetry suitable for CI delta comparisons. Adds a snapshot-compare CI hook that diffs two .hssnap artifacts and computes an SLO-aware stability delta (configurable thresholds per-cohort). If the stability delta exceeds thresholds the CI check fails with a concise failure report and suggested remediation hints (reduce exemplar variance, widen SLOs, run expanded shadow eval).

Files changed: lists include the core implementation under src/eval/hetero_shot_stability.py, the CI hook at ci/hooks/snapshot_compare.py, small CLI wrapper bin/hssnap (create/compare), schema additions in schema/snapshot_v1.yaml, unit tests in tests/test_hetero_stability.py, and docs in docs/eval/heterogeneous_shots.md.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of stability checker and comparator
- [x] Unit tests covering fingerprint generation and compare logic
- [x] CI hook integration and smoke test
- [x] Documentation and example prompt-set 
- [x] Backwards-compatible snapshot format with clear versioning

Rollout plan: the new CI hook is opt-in via .hssnap artifacts stored as build artifacts. Default thresholds are conservative (median stability delta > 0.15 triggers a soft fail in the dashboard but hard fail in CI only when explicitly opted-in via repo CI config). We will run this in shadow mode for 2 weeks on redwood/examples and opt-in repositories before recommending wider enabling.

Related: addresses ENG-1452 (reduce noise in prompt regression alerts) and complements existing cohort-based eval gates by focusing on sample-wise shot sensitivity.

Notes for reviewers: the snapshot format is intentionally compact (fingerprints + small skew sketches) to keep CI transfer sizes small and avoid full response diffs. Performance: default run uses sampled subset (configurable) to limit cost on CI; we include an optional longer-run mode for nightly jobs.

merge_commit_message:
Squash: Add heterogeneous-shot stability checker + compact snapshot comparator

Implements sample-level fingerprints and CI snapshot diff hook to detect shot-driven prompt regressions. Includes tests and documentation.

Refs: ENG-1452, PM-233
release_notes: Add heterogeneous-shot stability checks: opt-in CI snapshot compare (.hssnap) to surface regressions caused by few-shot exemplar variability. Configurable thresholds and compact snapshot format (v1).
notes: Shadow rollout recommended. Monitor false positives for small prompt-sets; adjust default thresholds after observing real repos.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover fingerprint hash stability, percentile scoring, and compare deltas. Integration smoke run included in CI. Recommend nightly expanded-run for 48h to build stable baseline on critical prompt-sets.
